title: Sightation Counts: Leveraging Sighted User Feedback in Building a BLV-aligned Dataset of Diagram Descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating VLM-generated diagram descriptions through comparative human assessments by Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) educators versus sighted educators to measure the misalignment (sighted-centric annotator bias) and the bias of standard automated metrics against BLV accessibility preferences.
